integrity: Exact algebraic proof plus independent finite checks for N=2..30; some historical primary full texts inaccessible; novelty priority not exhaustively certified.
scientific_limitations: Applies to every integer N >= 2, all positive real scalar weights assigned to projective directions and shared by parallel lines, and mean-zero conditioning; no optimality claimed for frequency filters or alternative projection bases.
title: Sharp scalar-view conditioning and a smallest-prime barrier for projective cyclic Radon transforms
